t: This is George Green's School, a coeducational secondary school and sixth form in Cubitt Town, on the Isle of Dogs in Tower Hamlets. It carries the name of its founder, George Green, who lived from 1767 to 1849. He was a shipbuilder from Blackwall, with a shipyard there, and he founded the school. So the name on the building belongs to a man from the Thames shipbuilding trade, and it still sits in the same part of east London.
